verdictMeaning: Bounded RAW source-figure fidelity only. The one-pixel fig25 PNG caption remnant is nonblocking for instructional content; this is not a zero-contamination claim.

checks.apparatus: Not applicable: source has no apparatus.
checks.grid: Source has no grid; none added.
checks.curve: All three rising runs, two full downward resets, three baseline crossings and the last partial run survive in both formats. No invented continuation.
checks.axes: Both source axes, extensions below/left of origin and up/right arrowheads preserved.
checks.labels: All three source glyph appearances and positions preserved, including the small subscript. No claim about Latin/Cyrillic encoding.
checks.arrows: Two axis arrowheads; no added curve arrows.
checks.crop: Recorded figure box [248,977,503,272], effective padding 12. PNG 527x296 is exactly the original crop [236,965,763,1261] in RGBA pixels. Both previews have complete arrows and low vertices; captions and neighboring apparatus are outside.
checks.stroke: PNG retains original scanned strokes and specks. SVG smooths/join-rounds pixel stair steps without changing visible topology, arrow direction or labels.

checks.apparatus: Both formats retain the whole black housing/lower band, circular double rim, light mount and all four fasteners. Original connected housing ink bounds are inclusive [864,800,1296,1288]; all fit the candidate.
checks.grid: Visible 19 vertical and 17 horizontal line tracks, approximately 17..19 px source spacing, scan offsets, short edge tracks and curved boundary fragments retained. Rim bands excluded from track counts. No invented rectangular cell total.
checks.curve: Left low trace, largest crest/trough and progressively smaller right-hand oscillations retained. No constant-amplitude substitution, dashed restyling, omitted end oscillation or extension.
checks.axes: No separately drawn/labeled axes in source or candidates; central graticule lines are not mislabeled as axes.
checks.labels: No internal units, letters or numeric values invented. Instrument-name and figure-number captions are separately retained as cap blocks, not readable candidate content.
checks.crop: Padding 0: figure box [864,798,433,491], exclusive crop [864,798,1297,1289]. PNG 433x491 is pixel-identical to this original crop. Last housing pixels at y=1288 are retained. Caption separation is spatially narrow, not a full blank horizontal row.
checks.stroke: PNG is exact source raster. SVG rounds/smooths lattice intersections and scan noise but keeps distinguishable grid, rim, fasteners and oscillatory trace; the isolated caption-tip pixel is omitted.

findings.detail: One black pixel at original (1033,1288), local (169,490), belongs to the leading caption glyph component with inclusive bounds [1022,1288,1050,1319]. It falls on the PNG's last row. All other pixels of that component are outside the crop; no readable caption fragment is included. At the same location the existing SVG preview is opaque white.
findings.disposition: Reported only; no crop repair or rerender authorized. Retaining the full housing also requires its last row y=1288, so a whole-row trim would remove apparatus ink.
findings.inventoryRefinement: The independent inventory's caption Y range was approximate. Original-pixel connectivity after candidate inspection establishes this one-pixel tip at y=1288; the saved inventory was not edited.

hashVerification.method: SHA-256 over existing bytes; candidate/receipt/page/audit/native references also checked for declared byte lengths. Source-only, input-freeze and original checked before candidates. No rehash loops.
hashVerification.previewBinding: Hash-checked existing receipts name the respective SVG and PNG preview paths and report exitCode 0. No native stage was executed; existing preview bytes, not a new render, were inspected.
